payload.claim: Criterion 1's witness (`test_a_task_whose_declared_mutant_survives_its_witness_never_reaches_review`) replaces `saffron.gates.runner.run_suite` wholesale with a stub that calls `witness_gate` directly, so none of `run_suite`'s or `run_witness`'s own body in `saffron/gates/runner.py` (lines 302-346, 165-299) ever executes during this test. The criterion's own text says 'Each runs the real `witness` gate under the real suite's advisory set,' which this witness only half-delivers: it exercises the real `witness_gate` function and the real `_advisory`/`_compare`/task-state wiring in `saffron/gates/suite.py`, but not the real production call path that wires a mutant and a tests subset into `witness_gate` in a live cell. A wrong version of `run_suite`/`run_witness` that always hands back a canned `witness` result (so no mutant is ever applied and no witness subset is ever run) leaves this test green, because that code path is never reached by the monkeypatch.
